Splitify for Android (Android 8.0 / API 26 or later). Installs as an update over any earlier version; your data stays in your Google account. Runs entirely on Firebase's free plan.

## What's new

**Search from Home**
- One search bar finds events and any item inside them: item names, categories, notes and who paid. Hidden events are included and marked.
- Results are grouped into Events and Items with matches highlighted. Opening an item jumps to its event with the list already filtered to it.

**Hide events**
- Hide an event to remove its card from Home. It moves to a **Hidden events** folder at the bottom, where you can open or unhide it. Hiding only changes your own view.

**Phone notifications**
- New in-app notifications appear in the phone's notification tray while the app is open or running in the background. Tap one to open its event.
- The closed-app push notifications introduced in v1.6.0 were removed, as they would require a paid Firebase plan.

## Install
Download **Splitify-v1.6.1.apk** below and open it on your Android device.
